question: How is the seed of knowledge activated and placed within the creative seat?
premises: A seed-drop of knowledge is placed in the triangular seat.
It is agitated three times before being placed.
Knowledge stirred by will becomes active in the level of reflective action.
inference: The rite activates knowledge through will and reflective action, then deposits it as a generative seed in the fire-pit.
plain_english: There one should agitate the seed-drop of knowledge three times and place it; knowledge, stirred by will, becomes active in the level of reflective action.
